coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 6 of 11 ground-truth items (55%): all three required prompting methods and all three benchmark tasks. The required constants and base-10 logarithmic inference-time metric are not matched.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Specifies A100-80GB GPUs or API deployment instead of an NVIDIA A100-PCIE-40GB GPU, and 3 runs instead of 10 per task. Fixed random seeds and the same framework installation and BoT repository configuration are not specified. Reports raw latency rather than log10 inference time per instance in seconds. Also adds CoT and additional metrics outside the ground-truth design.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Provides neither the expected inference-time comparison nor the task-specific logarithmic timing results. The reference shows BoT slower than Expert on all tasks and slower than PAL on MGSM and Checkmate-in-One, but faster than PAL on Game of 24.
